name: Bitwarden
tagline: Open source, independently audited, free tier that covers everything you need
highlights: Fully open source — Cure53 completed an independent audit in 2022
Free tier includes unlimited vault items on unlimited devices
Self-hosting option available for users who want complete data control
verdict: The gold standard for transparency — open source, audited, and the free tier covers everything most users need.
bestFor: Anyone who wants the most transparent, independently auditable password manager at the lowest cost

name: Proton Pass
tagline: Open source, privacy-focused, with built-in email aliases — from the Proton team
highlights: Open source clients audited by Cure53 in 2023
Built-in email aliases via SimpleLogin — a unique alias per service you sign up for
Swiss jurisdiction — Proton AG is bound by Swiss privacy law
verdict: The strongest privacy bundle — open source, audited, email aliases built in. Reliability still catching up to Bitwarden.
bestFor: Privacy-focused users who want email aliasing alongside their password manager, or who already use the Proton ecosystem

name: 1Password
tagline: Secret Key architecture, never been breached, best UX in the category — no free tier
highlights: Secret Key architecture: vault requires both master password and a 34-character device key
Never been breached in 17+ years of operation
Best-in-class browser integration and family/team sharing features
verdict: Strongest security architecture and track record — but closed source and no free tier drops it to third.
bestFor: Teams, families, and users who prioritise UX and breach history over open source auditability

name: Keeper
tagline: Enterprise compliance credentials — SOC 2 Type 2 and FedRAMP authorised
highlights: SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP authorised — strongest compliance credentials in the category
FIDO2 hardware key support and biometric authentication on all platforms
Excellent platform coverage: Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, all major browsers
verdict: The right choice for enterprise compliance requirements. For consumers, Bitwarden is strictly better at lower cost.
bestFor: Business users and individuals with compliance or audit requirements who need enterprise-grade certifications

name: NordPass
tagline: From Nord Security — XChaCha20 encryption, Cure53 audited, free tier limited
highlights: XChaCha20 encryption — more modern than the AES-256 used by most competitors
Built by Nord Security — same parent company as NordVPN
verdict: Decent but outclassed. Bitwarden offers more transparency at a lower price; Proton Pass offers better privacy at the same price.
bestFor: Existing NordVPN subscribers who want a bundled security solution from a single vendor

name: Dashlane
tagline: Polished UI with bundled VPN and dark web monitoring — most expensive option
highlights: Bundled VPN (Hotspot Shield) and dark web monitoring included in premium
Password health score gives a clear view of weak or reused passwords
verdict: Good product at an unjustifiable price. The VPN bundle is not a reason to pay 6x Bitwarden's price.
bestFor: Users who specifically want dark web monitoring and a VPN bundled with their password manager in a single subscription
